question: After refreshing this branch against current main, should the outbound owner approve the unified claim-fenced queue transition boundary for all supported channel transports?
rationale: This is an intentional shared ownership refactor in a message-delivery recovery path; automated checks and contributor proof support it, but maintainers must accept the centralization and its exact merged behavior.

options.title: Refresh and approve
options.body: Rebase or update the branch, confirm the exact merge result retains the demonstrated queue and recovery invariants, then merge.

options.title: Request narrower separation
options.body: Keep live and recovered transition ownership separate only if maintainers identify a concrete transport-specific invariant that the shared owner cannot represent.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve
recommendation.body: Rebase or update the branch, confirm the exact merge result retains the demonstrated queue and recovery invariants, then merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows direct ownership of the queue consolidation and its follow-up corrections.
